elements.note: The tool's screen, full frame: a prompt in the tool's input, highlighted word by word in yellow-green as the voiceover reads it.
The presenter in a circle in the bottom-right corner (placement circle-br), explaining what is on screen.

note: Screen explained by a face: the screen gets the frame, the person shrinks to a corner circle, so the viewer gets both the thing and the human. Captions are one word at a time in a white box with black text on the left, level with the circle, so they sit in the empty bottom-left instead of over the screen.
